Shri Suresh Gopi, Minister of State in the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Minister of State, MoPNG confirmed that comprehensive HSE audits are conducted semi-annually under OISD guidelines. All rigs possess valid statutory certifications.
Minister of State, MoPNG informed that ONGC regularly engages trade apprentices and conducts localized recruitment drives for non-executive positions through state employment exchanges.
Minister of State, MoPNG informed that ONGC strictly complies with Presidential Directives on reservation. Roster registers are monitored by the Chief Liaison Officer.
Minister of State, MoPNG stated that Government guidelines allow CPSEs to offer marginal discoveries to private operators under revenue sharing models to boost domestic output.
Minister of State, MoPNG stated that production enhancement contracts (PEC) and advanced IOR/EOR techniques are being implemented to arrest natural reservoir decline.

Minister of State, MoPNG tabled statement confirming ONGC disbursed mandatory CSR funds across education, healthcare, and drinking water projects in designated districts of TR in accordance with Schedule VII.

As on 30.07.2026, ONGC has 3,561 regular employees working in Assam (1,518 Executives, 2,043 Non-Executives; Group A: 1,352, Group B: 166, Group C: 1,796, Group D: 247) and 30 vacancies (all Non-Executive; Group C: 24, Group D: 6).
